answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 149827 Country: India Title: One person related to my business is giving me a motorcycle as my commission which he is buying by a loan taken from bank on interest. Will I be sinful of paying interest even if I am not paying a single rupee myself? Question: One person related to my business is giving me a motorcycle as my commission which he is buying by a loan taken from bank on interest. Will I be sinful of paying interest even if I am not paying a single rupee myself? Answer ID: 149827 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 840/818/L=7/1438) No, you will not be sinful for paying the interest, the person will get its sin who will pay the interest. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
